# tsuru_team (Resource)

Manages a tsuru team. Changing `name` renames the team in place: tsuru updates the apps, services, service instances, volumes and pools that reference it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tsuru_team" "my-team" {
  name = "my-team"
  tags = ["backend", "payments"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name

### Optional

- `tags` (List of String) Tags of the team
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tsuru_team.resource_name "name"

# example
terraform import tsuru_team.my-team "my-team"
```
